title: Redstone slab
description: Adds a survival friendly redstone slab.
body:
It's exactly what the title says, a redstone slab with the same redstone properties as a redstone block. It's survival friendly and craftable with 3 redstone blocks just like any other slab recipe. I made this mod for a minecraft build im trying to do.

If you encounter any bugs, dont bother trying to contact me, i wont do any updates on this, sorry.
